metadata.description: Demo environment name. Used to derive resource names.
Primary region. EU only — Case Study 33 hard rule.
Tags applied to every resource.
Object id of the principal that runs azd (assigned admin roles on Key Vault, AML, etc.). Defaults to the deployer at runtime — set explicitly when running outside azd.

Deploy Microsoft Purview. Disabled by default: some tenants do not have EU service locations available for Purview (only US). When false, lineage/classification governance is documented as a follow-up rather than provisioned.

Deploy Microsoft Fabric capacity. Disabled by default: requires at least one Fabric admin member configured upfront (Power BI/Fabric admin), and is not on the critical path for Case Study 33 acceptance.
CIDR of the demo VNet.
APIM service name (forms apim-{envName}.azure-api.net).
APIM Internal-mode private IP, read from the existing APIM resource by main.bicep.
Object id that gets Key Vault Administrator. Optional — leave empty if running with az CLI default.
Resource id of the privatelink.openai.azure.com Private DNS Zone to register the PE A record in.
Azure OpenAI deployment name used by apps and pipelines (model: gpt-5.4-nano).
Deployment SKU type. GlobalStandard recommended for the demo (no PTU reservation).
SKU capacity. For GlobalStandard / Standard this is TPM in thousands (50 = 50K TPM). For ProvisionedManaged this is the PTU count.
Log Analytics workspace resource id for diagnostic settings (required for EU AI Act audit trail).
Publisher email for APIM registration.
Publisher org displayed in the developer portal.
Key Vault name where the APIM subscription primary key will be persisted as a secret.
Secret name in Key Vault for the APIM subscription primary key.
Tokens-per-minute cap enforced per APIM subscription. Set ≤ AOAI deployment TPM.

KV secret name for the APIM subscription primary key.
APIM Internal gateway URL (e.g. https://apim-learneu-demo.azure-api.net).
AOAI deployment name (path segment for chat completions).
Fabric admin members (user/group object ids). At least one required.
